name: Om Power Transmission Ltd
title: Om Power Transmission Ltd - 544750 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Maiden call of a T&D EPC: FY26 revenue INR 449 crore (+61%), order book INR 621 crore (book-to-bill 1.38x), EBITDA margin steady at 12.7%, with management guiding 50% growth in FY27 and 12-13% EBITDA margin.

triggers.label: FY27 growth ~50% reaffirmed
triggers.quote: Whatever historical performance we have shown in the last three fiscals, with the same performance we will grow in this fiscal '27 as well.

triggers.label: Tender pipeline INR 900+ crore
triggers.quote: in the end of March '26, we have more than INR 900 crores in our pipeline.

triggers.label: Order book flat-to-down vs RHP
triggers.quote: our order book was INR 745 crores at the end of December '25, the numbers in our RHP.

guidance.quote: Whatever historical performance we have shown in the last three fiscals, with the same performance we will grow in this fiscal '27 as well.
We are expecting to maintain an EBITDA between 12% to 13% and PAT margin of 8% to 9%.
We are expecting to maintain an EBITDA between 12% to 13% and PAT margin of 8% to 9%.

red_flags.label: Order book slipping: INR 745 cr Dec-25 to INR 621 cr Mar-26
red_flags.quote: our order book was INR 745 crores at the end of December '25, the numbers in our RHP.

red_flags.label: Underground cabling order book ~2-3% of total
red_flags.quote: the order book has only 2% from the underground cabling segment.

red_flags.label: Management evasive on 50% growth and inflow
red_flags.quote: Not necessarily, ma'am. That depends on the -- when we bid for the tenders.

red_flags.label: Raw material inflation pass-through unverified
red_flags.quote: all our POs have price variation calculations.

evasions.topic: FY27 order inflow and order book target
evasions.quote: Not necessarily, ma'am. That depends on the -- when we bid for the tenders.
So in the near three months, we will recover that too, sir.
Sir, speaking about this, the financial year was ending, sir, so a lot of tenders are in our pipeline.
